## Reading

Measured by the #18400 dev at 10:45Z and re-read by the seat at 10:51Z through the row's own spelling.

What the spec seat measured on #6017 (comment 5692971090) was also real: the SAME two PRs read no enqueued row at +0 s and +75 s after the `pull_request.enqueued` webhook. The row therefore materialises LATE and BACKDATED to the enqueue instant (PR #18423: row `created_at` 10:37:12Z against the webhook reaching this seat at 10:37:13Z). The block has no row saying so, and that gap has now cost two seats a filing (#18400, and the reading on #6017 that fed it): a seat reading the timeline right after its own enqueue takes an absence as a negative reading, which the file does not license.

## What is asked

Wording waits on the bound below; ⛔ do not invent a bound.

Work item 1 (measurement, this seat, no dispatch): at the next enqueue this seat performs (PR #18437 once its checks converge), poll `GET /issues/{pr}/timeline` at +30 s / +2 min / +5 min and record on this card when the `added_to_merge_queue` row first reads back. Work item 2 (dispatch after 1): the row :12 re-key with the measured bound; references fact layer ⇒ default-tier build, in-seat review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, in-seat landing.

Bound known today: absent at +75 s (spec seat, two PRs), present at +8 min (PR #18423, this seat, 10:45Z) and at +4 h (PR #18370 / #18371). NOT MEASURED between +75 s and +8 min.
